forcing_mechanism.evidence: Firms under 250 staff get up to 4,500 euros per level 5 apprentice contract starting before 1 January 2027.

findable.evidence: SIRENE names companies with NAF code and staff band; France Travail ads name the employer, NAF code and contract type.

early.evidence: France Travail ads update continuously, so hiring intent shows before the 1 January 2027 start-date cutoff.

gap_evidence.evidence: No catalogue dataset records apprentice contracts or aid claims, which run through the skills operator and payment agency.

crowding.evidence: Aid payment depends on the monthly payroll declaration, a filing every French payroll tool already produces.

list_recipes.filter: apprenticeship (apprentissage) in typeContrat or intitule, codeNAF 55, 56, 47 or 41-43, trancheEffectifEtab 10-249
list_recipes.gap_evidence: open apprentice ad means a contract not yet signed before 1 January 2027
list_recipes.metric: open apprentice ads per company times 4,500 euros maximum aid
list_recipes.caveat: An open ad shows hiring intent only, since the aid claim runs through the skills operator outside this data.

list_recipes.gap_evidence: none in the data; staff band shows eligibility for the under-250 rate only
list_recipes.metric: count of eligible establishments per company
list_recipes.caveat: SIRENE shows eligibility, not whether a company hires apprentices or claims the aid.
